name: A / First-time onboarding
note: Approval is conceptual and depends on an authorized banking partner and identity process. Permission refusal must allow a safe return. Account entry is gated on verification.

name: B / Domestic transfer
main: Review recipient, fee and total debit
note: Invalid recipient → UI-39 → edit reference. Insufficient funds → UI-40 → reduce amount. Cancel before authorization → review. Confirmed failure → UI-28: no debit, review before retry. Expired session → UI-47 → sign in and refresh quote.

name: C / Bill payment
note: Lookup failure → UI-41. Unpaid bill is a retrieval result, not a payment authorization. Timeout after submission must resolve status by reference before another payment is offered.

name: D / Freeze and restore a card
note: A freeze is reversible and does not replace a lost/stolen report. Existing authorizations may settle. If the issuer update fails, retain prior status, show failure and offer support; never show Frozen without confirmation.

name: E / Intelligent transaction search
main: Refine or clear the applied filters
note: AI-enabled steps: interpretation and optional matching explanation. No result → UI-42 → widen filters. Monetary totals come from matching source rows, never generated prose.

name: F / Budget and spending insights
main: Choose a period and account scope
Set or adjust a category budget
note: No transactions → empty period state. Budget is a planning limit, not a card limit or automatic transfer. Savings balance is shown separately; insights exclude transfers and savings moves.
